definitionZh: @media CSS at-rule 可以根据一个或多个媒体查询的结果应用部分样式表. 您用它指定一个介质查询和一个 CSS 块来应用到文档中,如果并且只有在介质查询与使用内容的设备相匹配时。
sourceDefinition: The @media CSS at-rule can be used to apply part of a style sheet based on the result of one or more media queries. With it, you specify a media query and a block of CSS to apply to the document if and only if the media query matches the device on which the content is being used.
